top_signals.title: Xi, Putin Assail Trade Barriers Ahead of Summit With Trump
top_signals.summary: Xi Jinping warned against economic barriers and urged closer cooperation among Asia-Pacific nations ahead of talks with Donald Trump, as new US restrictions on China’s access to advanced AI chips strain a fragile trade truce.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Erases Bessent Rally as Leverage and Liquidity Fade
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin has erased all the gains from its late-summer rally as fading risk appetite and the record hack at exchange Binance drove investors to retreat, leaving the largest token trading in a thinner market increasingly vulnerable to sharp price swings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: With Jensen Huang gone, Colette Kress shows Nvidia is still at the center of AI
top_signals.summary: In her first earnings report as interim CEO, Nvidia's Colette Kress calmed investors' nerves, at least for the moment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Alstom Falls on Expectations of Equity Raise to Reduce Debt
top_signals.summary: Alstom SA declined after the troubled French trainmaker lowered expectations for asset sales to help pay down debt, putting the possibility of a rights issue in view.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
